children: Estate of Alvin Libin Discloses 10.11% Stake in Riley Exploration Permian

The Estate of Alvin Libin, through its wholly owned company Balmon Investments Inc., reported a 10.11% stake in Riley Exploration Permian, Inc. The Alberta court appointed five estate trustees on Nov. 12, 2026, and the estate filed its Schedule 13D on Nov. 19. The disclosure records ownership transferred by law after Alvin G. Libin’s death; it does not announce a new market purchase.

The estate, Balmon Investments and the trustees say they “currently have no plans or proposals” for the actions listed in Item 4. They reserve the right to change course after assessing Riley Exploration Permian’s business and market conditions.

The Estate of Alvin Libin is administered by Alberta courts, and five trustees—Robert Libin, Eda Libin, Bruce Libin, Eldon Smith and Darcy Moch—act for it. The estate wholly owns Balmon Investments Inc., an Alberta company that directly holds all 2,236,921 Riley common shares covered by the filing. The filing describes this ownership as a transfer by operation of law, rather than a recent open-market purchase.
